title: Multivariate energy-weighted Q3 source bound
question: Does A(q,v)=1+q^4+v^4 absorb the actual Q3 source polynomial in both spatial orientations for every real q,v and |a|<=1/4?
method: Reconstruct the actual center and source-at-neighbor Q3 polynomials from the registered potential in primary SymPy and independent Fraction lanes.

Compute the coefficient-majorant constant with source radius 1/4, verify field degree at most three and source degree at most four, and check the equivalent fourth-power inequality on 98 exact grid points for each orientation.
Compile Lean R236 for the exact coefficient sum, orientation equality, degree and positivity fixtures while preserving the pointwise/operator scope firewall.
finding: For A(q,v)=1+q^4+v^4 and |a|<=1/4, every actual Q3 source monomial has field degree at most three. The exact coefficient triangle gives C=122099/35840 for both orientations, and both lanes reproduce the all-real monomial-majorant structure and 98-point fourth-power grid checks. The result is a pointwise commuting scalar bound; the Q3 common-core, weighted product and spatial history remain open.
decision_reason: This is the direct multivariate lift after EXP-001053. It confirms that the candidate energy weight absorbs the actual two-orientation local source at the scalar level, so the next blocker is specifically operator-domain/product/history realization rather than the local polynomial growth itself.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing multivariate scalar interface. It is pointwise and commutative and does not establish the Q3 operator common core, product histories, factorial incidence or thermodynamic QFT.

adversarial_review.check: The all-real statement uses the coefficient majorant and monomial degree bounds; the 98-point grid is a self-test only.
Center and source-at-neighbor polynomials and coefficient sums are computed independently.
The estimate assumes |a|<=1/4 exactly and does not infer unrestricted source amplitude.
The commuting pointwise estimate is not promoted to an operator, common-core or central-context theorem.
C=122099/35840 is recomputed from all coefficients and source powers in both lanes.
R236 checks exact coefficient/orientation fixtures only, not domains or histories.
No factorial incidence, KMS/OS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.
No heat_root_incidence or A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.
